steps.en: Offender is logged in and the session holds their NRIC
steps.id: Offender sudah login dan session menyimpan NRIC-nya

steps.en: The Clearance Slip page opens after login
steps.id: Halaman Clearance Slip terbuka setelah login
steps.why_en: The portal has no Clearance Slip page at all; only payment and furnish pages exist.
steps.why_id: Portal tidak punya halaman Clearance Slip sama sekali; hanya ada halaman pembayaran dan furnish.

steps.en: The page asks whether a clearance slip can be generated
steps.id: Halaman menanyakan apakah clearance slip bisa dibuat
steps.why_en: No request for a clearance check exists; the portal only searches fines to pay.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada request pengecekan clearance; portal hanya mencari denda untuk dibayar.

steps.en: The NRIC comes from the login, not from typing
steps.id: NRIC diambil dari login, bukan diketik

steps.en: All notices of the offender are loaded by NRIC
steps.id: Semua notice offender diambil lewat NRIC
steps.why_en: Notices are found by NRIC, but only to build a list of fines to pay, not for clearance.
steps.why_id: Notice ditemukan lewat NRIC, tapi hanya untuk daftar denda yang dibayar, bukan untuk clearance.

steps.en: Notices that became arrest warrants are recognised
steps.id: Notice yang sudah jadi warrant dikenali
steps.why_en: Warrant stages are recognised, but only to show payment terms, not to judge clearance.
steps.why_id: Stage warrant dikenali, tapi hanya untuk syarat pembayaran, bukan menilai clearance.

steps.en: All arrest warrants are checked as permanently suspended
steps.id: Semua warrant dicek sudah suspended permanen
steps.why_en: No check that every warrant is permanently suspended exists.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada pengecekan bahwa semua warrant sudah suspended permanen.

steps.en: The system checks the past-X-months condition
steps.id: Sistem mengecek kondisi X bulan terakhir
steps.why_en: A fixed 6-month window exists, but only on another search and not tied to clearance.
steps.why_id: Ada window 6 bulan tetap, tapi hanya di pencarian lain dan tidak terkait clearance.

steps.en: Pre-defined conditions can be set without code changes
steps.id: Kondisi yang ditentukan bisa diatur tanpa ubah code
steps.why_en: No clearance rules or settings exist anywhere in the code.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada aturan atau setting clearance di code.

steps.en: The page learns whether a clearance slip can be generated
steps.id: Halaman tahu apakah clearance slip bisa dibuat
steps.why_en: No eligibility result is produced; the response is only a list of fines.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada hasil kelayakan; respons hanya daftar denda.
